data.body: VALIDATION_LIVE_EVIDENCE: PROGRESS 2026-05-25T23:14Z. PR #354 (bug 96c5) MERGED — --detach + update-ref fix worked: dry-run run https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/26423439381 progressed PAST the dual-worktree conflict to the inner 'git commit' step. THIRD defect surfaced: git commit fails exit 128 because the CI runner has no global git identity configured and the workflow's git config step runs AFTER the reconciler step (and in a different worktree). Filed P1 bug bbf0-3380-74ab-4200 (child of this epic). Same anti-pattern class as 5be7 + 96c5 — production code makes runtime-env assumptions the test fixture happens to satisfy on dev. Strategic remediation: real-git CI-like integration test (HOME=/tmp/fake-home, no pre-mounted worktrees) would have caught all three pre-merge.
